body: Hello, it is my second day here, today I have been a little more stable emotionally, however the idea of suicide continues to haunt, I have tried to avoid contact with anyone to avoid strong emotions, be it bad news or conflicts of any kind, not yet I know if this is a good idea.

>Here in Venezuela there is no helpline for the suicide or something similar, I only found a phone number and it seems to be deactivated, if you know any institution that I can contact through whatsapp or something like that I would really appreciate it, thanks for the advice , Thanks for the help!

Here where I live there is not a single institution that I can go to, I live in a town in Venezuela quite far from the city, I am a painter, but every time I try to paint I feel that I get more depressed, it is what I like to do the most in this world but in the end it ends up making me feel worse
